On your own schedule

What your
learning
journey looks like.

↗Start with the welcome

Once your access is confirmed, begin with Welcome to Brand Academy, then Welcome and Orientation, and Find your way.

↗Learn in manageable sessions

Work through the six modules at your own pace. Watch, read, practise and return when you’re ready to continue.

↗Apply your judgement

Use the examples and practical activities to connect the learning to your brand and stores. Bring your understanding together in the final assessment.

↗Tell us what needs work

Note confusing instructions, access issues and anything that would make the learning more useful. Your pilot feedback helps shape the next release.

A few things worth knowing

Your questions, answered.

↗

How much time should I set aside?

Plan for around 2.5 hours of active learning for your first brand pathway, spread across sessions if helpful. This is an estimate that the pilot will help us test.

↗

Do I need to attend a live workshop?

The core learning is self-paced. Follow the timing in your pilot invitation and work through the materials when it suits you.

↗

Which brand should I focus on?

Follow the brand scope confirmed in your pilot invitation. If it is missing or incorrect, reply to the invitation before continuing.

I registered for training. Do I already have a Thinkific account?

Training registration and a Thinkific account are separate. Registration captures your training details, including brands and stores. Follow your pilot invitation for account setup and access instructions; registering does not itself unlock the course.

I can sign in, but I can’t see the course. What should I do?

Check that you’re using the email address confirmed for your pilot access. If the course is still missing, reply to your invitation with the email address you used and what you see on screen. Avoid creating a second account.

Can I request another brand?

Update your registration below with the additional brand and relevant stores. Wait for confirmation of the learning access you need.

Does completing the learning give me permission to publish?

Learning completion and operational access are separate. Continue to follow the applicable Content Workflow and approvals. Your team will confirm any next steps for access.
